services.name: Kayak Rentals
services.desc: A1A Beach Rentals and Outdoor Center serves the Cocoa Beach area with a variety of kayaks to rent, including those for one or two people. We also provide kayak eco tours in which you can see the local wildlife. Free delivery on orders over $100. We have a great variety of kayaks, including singles, tandems, sit-on-tops, and surfing kayaks. Guided trips extra. We also provide all kinds of kayak accessories for your convenience, including kayak carts, dry bags, anchors and more. We have negotiated premium launch sites around town for viewing manatees and dolphins, as well as great fishing, and bioluminescence evening trip too!
